resolution: Identified outdated browser cookie conflict; instructed customer to clear mobile browser cache and checkout completed.

subject: Technical: Live tracking webhook latency alert
problem: Customer stated tracking status lagged behind carrier physical delivery notification.
resolution: Verified carrier EDI 214 delivery event synced with 15-minute queue latency; confirmed delivery in Horizon system.

subject: Technical: Gift card balance checker downtime
problem: Customer reported error loading balance lookup portal resa-cards.internal/balance.
resolution: Escalated transient DNS resolution error to IT Helpdesk; service restored within 15 minutes under Severity-2 SLA.

subject: Technical: Email notification bounce for order dispatch

resolution: Updated communication log, sent SMS text notification with tracking link, and archived delivery status.

subject: Technical: VPN connection failure to internal support tools

resolution: Verified gateway address vpn.resasupport.com:8443, guided agent to open outbound UDP port 443, and restored VPN tunnel.
